title: COOPERATION AS A BLACK BOX: CONCEPTUAL FLUCTUATION AND DIAGNOSTIC TOOLS FOR MISALIGNMENT IN MAS
reasoning: The paper introduces a diagnostic framework called the 'Misalignment Mosaic,' which includes 'Morality as Cooperation' as a core component. It specifically evaluates the relationship between technical coordination and moral interpretation in Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), incorporating ethical theories and moral reasoning into its conceptual analysis of system alignment.
